name: subconscious-code
description: Coding-focused chat for the Subconscious engine. Shares workspaces and threads with the Subconscious desktop app.

enumDescriptions: Ask for confirmation before each mutating tool action.
Run eligible tools automatically without asking (autonomous).
subconscious.agent.autonomyMode.description: How the agent handles approvals for mutating tool actions. Comparable to the auto-approve posture in GitHub Copilot and Kiro.

subconscious.tools.autoApprove.description: Automatically approve all tool invocations without confirmation. When enabled, overrides the autonomy mode to run autonomously (mirrors GitHub Copilot's chat.tools.autoApprove). Use with caution.

subconscious.mcp.enabled.description: Discover and host Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers declared in the workspace MCP configuration file, exposing their tools to the agent.

subconscious.mcp.configFile.description: Path to the MCP server configuration file (VS Code standard 'servers' format), relative to the workspace root or absolute.

subconscious.autoStartEngine.description: Automatically start the Subconscious engine if it isn't already running.

subconscious.engineCommand.description: Command used to launch the Subconscious engine (must be on PATH).

subconscious.dev.description: Connect to the development engine instance (uses the '-dev' data directory and passes --dev when spawning).

subconscious.dataDir.description: Override the Subconscious data directory used to discover the engine (leave blank for the platform default).

subconscious.toolTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time, in seconds, a coding tool may run before the agent tool call times out (5–600 seconds).

subconscious.maxReadBytes.description: Maximum number of bytes the read-file tool returns before the content is truncated (1,024–104,857,600 bytes).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run build:media
